integrity: Analytic proof and a standalone Python standard-library checker accompany this result. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp formula for excitation index at least two is a small-area first-order asymptotic, not a finite-area classification. Individual pure-state concentration, not all superpositions, is optimized. Historical priority may be limited by unlocated earlier literature.
title: A two-band concentration law for vacuum and excited Gaussian Fock modes
